description: Demo MBS template: broadcast a real live DASH stream (DASH-IF's livesim2 WAVE test vector, 'croatia' 1920x1080@25fps) over 5G MBS. One Ingest Session in PULL/STREAMING mode -- MBSTF fetches the manifest + segments directly from DASH-IF's server and FLUTE-delivers them. Load, then Activate the session in the portal. Verified end-to-end against a real running rt-mbs stack (MBSF, MBSTF, MB-SMF/MB-UPF, rt-mbs-client, rt-mbs-application).
